why: Show visible cast-preparation progress during long editor loading and preserve correct progress under stale/rejected work.

processCleanup: The real-art benchmark wrote complete=true after source rechecks and closed its browser children, but the Node/caffeinate wrapper remained live beyond four minutes. Its exact two owned PIDs were terminated (exit143). Completion claims concern recorded assertions, not a clean process exit. Controlled progress verifier exited0.
limits: Controlled progress test uses deferred appearance promises with real EditorMap renderer and native snapshot, not actual raster-preparation cancellation.
Underlying appearance work is not cancelled by this feature; revision guards prevent obsolete UI updates.
Loading screenshot is the isolated renderer over the editor, not a normal public import capture.
